note: The one-dimensionality of the divergence-free centered tensors is differential_rank and the nonzero J with the refined scaling and positive normalization converging to the Maxwell stress is produce_current; both take the stable weak comparison and the free-stress certificate (FreeDiv) as hypotheses.

snippet.text:
theorem differential_rank (T : Lighthouse C.book) (p : T.W.Orientation a.spin)
    (hf : FreeDiv T a p) (hw : W.Derivatives S) (hh : T.W.Derivatives (Bel C.book))
    (X : Scaling S) (hz : Approaches (path X) (isoPanel X)) (ht : Stable H.spin a.spin W T.W X) :
    Surjective (currentDiv W H.spin ho) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (currentDiv W H.spin ho))=1 := by

theorem produce_current (H : S.Hierarchy) (hW : W.Derivatives S) (ho : W.Orientation H.spin)
    (a : (Bel C.book).Hierarchy) (T : Lighthouse C.book) (hV : T.W.Derivatives (Bel C.book)) (p : T.W.Orientation a.spin)
    (hT : FreeDiv T a p) (X : Scaling S) (hp : Approaches (path X) (isoPanel X)) (h : Stable H.spin a.spin W T.W X) :
    ∃ J : KernelSpace H.spin,∃ Y : Scaling S,J.val ≠ 0 ∧ currentDiv W H.spin ho J=0 ∧
      Approaches (path Y) (isoPanel Y) ∧ Stable H.spin a.spin W T.W Y ∧ Y.meter J.val T.J := by
